diagrams.title: From pain signal to recurring portfolio cashflow
diagrams.subtitle: Five-stage digital product value ladder
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values indicate operating sequence, not guaranteed conversion rates.
diagrams.caption: Validate willingness to pay before full asset production, then compound LTV via order bumps, 1-click upsells, and recurring updates.

stages.label: Validate pain
stages.detail: Mine Ad Libraries, search queries, and Reddit threads; pre-sell or smoke-test before full build.

stages.label: Ship core SKU
stages.detail: Package a modular template, toolkit, or micro-course that delivers a measurable win in 15 minutes.

stages.label: Expand basket
stages.detail: Attach a contextual $19-$29 order bump and a 1-click post-purchase implementation upsell.

stages.label: Automate onboarding
stages.detail: Deliver license tokens, Visa CE 3.0 receipts, and a 5-part activation sequence to cut refunds.

stages.label: Ascend LTV
stages.detail: Convert proven buyers into annual data feeds, paid communities, or quarterly template drops.

diagrams.title: Self-liquidating acquisition to backend ascension
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 1,000 targeted visitors
diagrams.assumptions_note: Invented nested cohort counts illustrating funnel math; actual conversion varies by traffic source and offer.
diagrams.caption: Newsletter co-registration and front-end order bumps offset acquisition spend so backend community and bundle sales become high-margin profit.

stages.label: Targeted clicks
stages.detail: High-intent visitors from YouTube tutorials, Reddit SERP threads, GEO citations, or paid tests.

stages.label: Lead-magnet opt-ins
stages.detail: 38% opt-in to a free calculator or lite template with optional paid newsletter co-registration.

stages.label: Core SKU buyers
stages.detail: 3.4% front-end conversion on a $49 operational toolkit or template system.

stages.label: Bump & upsell buyers
stages.detail: 38% order-bump attachment and 14% 1-click post-purchase bundle upgrades.

stages.label: Annual subscribers
stages.detail: Ascended members on a $290-$490/yr update feed or operator community.

diagrams.title: Gross checkout receipts to net contribution margin
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative $100 blended basket on Merchant-of-Record rails
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD per $100 gross checkout basket; opening and closing bars are totals, middle bars are deductions.
diagrams.caption: $100 gross receipts less $5.50 MoR processing, $4.00 refund reserve, $12.00 affiliate/support allocation, and $23.50 media spend leaves $55.00 contribution.

stages.label: Gross basket
stages.detail: Combined front-end SKU, order bump, and post-purchase upsell receipts excluding pass-through VAT.

stages.label: MoR & payment fee
stages.detail: Merchant-of-Record 5% + $0.50 fee handling global VAT/sales-tax remittance and fraud screening.

stages.label: Refunds & disputes
stages.detail: 4% combined refund and dispute allowance under clear click-to-cancel terms.

stages.label: Support & affiliates
stages.detail: Blended affiliate payout share and Tier-1 support/fulfillment automation cost.

stages.label: Net ad spend
stages.detail: Paid media outlay net of Day-1 SparkLoop / co-registration lead-magnet liquidation.

stages.label: Contribution margin
stages.detail: Closing contribution before fixed studio opex, contractor retainers, and owner taxes.

diagrams.title: Effective take-rate across checkout & distribution rails
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative % platform & payment fee on a $100 digital order
diagrams.assumptions_note: Percent of a $100 digital sale; excludes optional paid discovery boosts and state registration overhead.
diagrams.caption: Direct Stripe has the lowest card fee but leaves global VAT/Wayfair nexus compliance on the seller; MoR platforms absorb tax liability for ~2% more.

stages.label: Direct Stripe + Tax
stages.detail: 2.9% + $0.30 card fee plus ~0.5% Stripe Tax; seller still owns state/VAT registrations.

stages.label: MoR (Paddle / LS)
stages.detail: 5% + $0.50 Merchant-of-Record fee; MoR acts as legal seller and remits global VAT/sales tax.

stages.label: Gumroad Direct
stages.detail: 10% + $0.50 direct-link fee; simple starter rail but expensive above $10k/mo volume.

stages.label: App Store In-App
stages.detail: Standard 30% mobile store commission (15% Small Business Program) vs Web2App external web checkout.

diagrams.title: Checkout compliance, chargeback & piracy defense tree
diagrams.subtitle: Operational triage before scaling paid traffic
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numbers identify decision nodes; keep dispute ratio well below the 0.75% card-network threshold.
diagrams.caption: Prevent friendly-fraud chargebacks and group-buy leaks structurally through MoR tax handling, CE 3.0 logs, 1-click refunds, and fingerprinted files.

stages.label: Global tax covered?
stages.detail: Yes via MoR or registered tax engine: advance to Node 2. No: route international/nexus checkout to MoR.

stages.label: CE 3.0 telemetry?
stages.detail: Log IP, device, timestamp, license activation, and download events to win friendly-fraud representments.

stages.label: Dispute rate <0.4%?
stages.detail: Yes: scale traffic. Elevated: enable self-serve 1-click refunds/cancellations so unhappy buyers refund instead of disputing.

stages.label: Canary watermark?
stages.detail: Embed buyer-specific canary hashes and automate 17 U.S.C. 512(c) DMCA notices on leaked repos.

diagrams.title: One full-time architect, three specialized contractors
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative 4-person ($425k-$800k/yr) portfolio pod
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are role identifiers, not FTE salaries. All contractor work requires signed IP assignment.
diagrams.caption: Keep headcount lean by automating fulfillment, tax, and Tier-1 FAQ triage while focusing human talent on SKU quality and creative velocity.

stages.label: Owner / product architect
stages.detail: Owns market selection, offer positioning, pricing, funnel math, and capital allocation.

stages.label: Product & UI builder
stages.detail: Builds modular Notion/Sheets/Figma systems, calculators, and micro-extension updates under written IP assignment.

stages.label: Video & ad editor
stages.detail: Produces faceless YouTube tutorials, VSL hooks, and weekly Meta/TikTok creative variants.

stages.label: Ops & affiliate lead
stages.detail: Manages Tier-2 customer tickets, refund QA, DMCA sweeps, and affiliate/newsletter partner payouts.

diagrams.title: Disciplined $10,000 digital product launch allocation
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative pilot budget with 50% untouched cash reserve
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD; four additive components total $10,000 for a multi-SKU launch scenario. Serverless hosting and startup credits keep fixed tech COGS near zero.
diagrams.caption: Never sink $10,000 into unvalidated course production; cap initial build + legal setup and preserve liquidity for post-validation traffic scaling.

stages.label: Entity & IP setup
stages.detail: LLC formation, business banking, domain portfolio, and contractor work-made-for-hire / IP templates.

stages.label: Design & tooling
stages.detail: Screen-recording gear, analytics, email engine, and modular design assets not covered by free tiers.

stages.label: Validation ad tests
stages.detail: Bounded 72-hour pre-sale smoke tests and SLO creative experiments with strict kill gates.

stages.label: Operating reserve
stages.detail: Untouched liquidity buffer for scaling proven ROAS winners and covering payout timing.

diagrams.title: Thirty days from pain signal to cash-flowing SKU
diagrams.subtitle: Four weekly validation, build, launch & optimization gates
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are milestone end-days. Advance to paid scaling only after front-end unit economics clear target thresholds.
diagrams.caption: Ship a focused v1.0 painkiller in 14 days, validate real checkout conversion in Week 3, and lock onboarding + affiliate leverage by Day 30.

stages.label: Mine & pre-sell
stages.detail: Audit Ad Libraries and Reddit threads, wire MoR pre-sale lander, and confirm real buyer conversion.

stages.label: Build & wire SKU
stages.detail: Assemble modular v1.0 product, order bump, 1-click upsell, CE 3.0 webhooks, and 5-email onboarding.

stages.label: Launch & liquidate
stages.detail: Publish YouTube/Reddit/DM triggers, activate newsletter co-reg, and run $50/day SLO split tests.

stages.label: Audit & scale
stages.detail: Reconcile net contribution margin, cut refund friction, onboard affiliates, and scale winning hooks.
